Implemented the streaming lifecycle fix.

- Streaming runs now aggregate model usage into `RunContext` before completion (`packages/agents-core/src/run.ts:797`).
- Streaming runs emit `agent_end` on both the `Runner` and final `Agent`, matching non-streaming behavior (`packages/agents-core/src/run.ts:831`).
- Added a regression test verifying post-`run()` listeners receive `agent_end` exactly once and can access accumulated usage (`packages/agents-core/test/run.stream.test.ts:57`).

Validation:
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Tests and full type-check could not run because repository dependencies, including `vitest`, `zod`, and Node typings, are not installed.
